ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 to L.561-59 and R.561-1 et seq. of the French Code monétaire et financier (CMF) as the core AML/CFT statute; Articles L.561-46-1 et seq. CMF regarding fiducies and beneficial ownership transparency; Directive (EU) 2015/849 (4AMLD) and Directive (EU) 2018/843 (5AMLD), transposed by Ordinance No. 2020-115 and Decree No. 2020-1125; Code de commerce Articles L.223-1 et seq. (SARL statutory framework) and R.123-53 et seq. (UBO declaration filed with the RCS via the INPI Guichet Unique); Code pénal Articles 324-1 to 324-6 (money laundering and aggravated money laundering offences); Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on fund transfers; TRACFIN cooperation duties under Article L.561-21 CMF; UBO data protection and restricted access under law 78-17 (Informatique et Libertés) as interpreted following CJEU judgments C-37/20 and C-601/20 (22 November 2022)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access – the French beneficial-ownership register is no longer freely public after the CJEU rulings in C-37/20 and C-601/20; access is granted to competent authorities (TRACFIN, tax administration, customs, judicial authorities) and to AML/CFT obliged entities (credit institutions, notaries, auditors, lawyers) under a legitimate-interest regime; the mandatory RCS/INPI declaration must fully reveal natural-person ultimate beneficial owners, and any nominee or intermediate holding structure must be pierced to the natural person

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the articles of association (statuts) of each corporate shareholder, with certified English-to-French translation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin and certified translator (expert près la cour d'appel) for the French version

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of identity documents (passport or national identity card) of all qualifying shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent administrative authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter with professional reputation statement (attestation de réputation professionnelle) issued for a licensed foreign credit institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank holding the corporate or individual shareholder relationship

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory double-screening of all natural-person shareholders, UBOs, managers, and signatories against: (i) the UN Consolidated List as implemented by EU Regulation 881/2002 (Al-Qaida/ISIL) and EU Regulation 269/2014 (misappropriation/territorial integrity); (ii) EU Regulation 833/2014 (sectoral and financial restrictions); (iii) the OFAC SDN list on a re-check basis for USD wire transactions; (iv) TRACFIN and French ministerial asset-freeze measures (décisions de gel des fonds); (v) EU and domestic PEP databases in accordance with Article 3(9) of Directive 2015/849 and Article L.561-10 CMF; enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs, persons resident in FATF high-risk jurisdictions, or transactions involving non-cooperative third countries; the source of funds for the share capital contribution must be documented where the aggregate contribution exceeds EUR 10,000, and any beneficial-ownership doubt triggers a refusal of the incorporation mandate under Article L.561-8-1 CMF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI – Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) maintained by the greffe du tribunal de commerce; the preliminary name-release check is performed against the RCS database, the INPI trademark database, and the EUIPO database
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Latin-alphabet characters; if the intended name originates in a non-Latin script, an official transliteration into Latin characters is mandatory and the transliterated version will be the registered name. The name may be in French or in a foreign language, provided it does not mislead the public as to the nature, nationality, or regulated status of the business; non-French names are accepted but a French operating name is recommended for public procurement and medical-sector trust. A name that reproduces a registered trademark, a well-known mark, or a protected public designation is excluded under Articles L.711-2 and L.711-3 of the Code de la propriété intellectuelle
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a statutory name-reservation certificate; the preliminary availability check through the INPI Guichet Unique and the greffe's pre-filing admission review is deemed valid for a prudential window of 30 days. On rejection, the applicant may: (1) amend and re-submit the name in the same Guichet Unique business file; (2) contest the rejection by motion (référé) before the presiding judge of the Tribunal de commerce within one month of notification, under Article R.123-92 of the Code de commerce, where the greffe has erred on prior rights or public order; (3) where rejection is grounded on an INPI trademark conflict, the applicant may request cancellation or coexistence proof from the trademark owner and re-file after disposal of the conflict; the formal appeal does not suspend the 30-day window, and the registration officer's decision is subject to the ordinary remedies of commercial litigation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permitted for administrative purposes only. A French SARL may fix its siège social at the registered office of an approved domiciliation company (Article L.123-11-1, L.123-11-2 and R.123-135 et seq. of the Code de commerce) or, for a maximum of five years, at the gérant's personal residence in France. However, for a licensed Class III intraocular lens manufacturer, a pure virtual office cannot satisfy the commercial-substance and manufacturing requirements of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR). The notifying body and the Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé (ANSM) require physical premises for production, clean-room or controlled-environment operations, quality control, traceability, and complaint handling; a domiciliation address may supplement but never replace the manufacturing and post-market surveillance establishment.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High – quantified risk of 90 percent to 100 percent within the first 12 to 24 months of operation. ANSM may conduct unannounced physical inspections under Article L.5311-1 of the Code de la santé publique; the MDR-classified notified body must perform a pre-certification on-site audit of the manufacturing site and thereafter annual surveillance visits for Class III devices. Unannounced quality-system audits by the notified body are an explicit condition of ISO 13485 certification under EN ISO 13485 and MDR Annex IX, meaning the physical presence of the registered office and manufacturing site will be verified in almost every compliance cycle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory greffe tariff (approximately EUR 38.27) plus regulated legal-announcement tariff (approximately EUR 180 to 220 for a national publication)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères (Service de légalisation) and the French Consulate for non-Hague States

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of corporate documents (statuts, powers of attorney, certificates) into French by a court-registered translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Expert près la cour d'appel / certified legal translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of EUR 65 to 95 per standard page including certification

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee for a single-shareholder or multi-shareholder SARL; hourly rate range EUR 240 to 450 for additional UBO complexity

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general commercial company provisions) and Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation, management, and obligations); implementing provisions of Decree No. 2023-218 via the Guichet Unique; for market access, Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR) and French Public Health Code (Code de la santé publique), Articles L.5211-1 seq. and R.5211-1 seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), administered by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris); filings are transmitted electronically through the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) Guichet Unique in accordance with the French business formalities portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) executed either sous seing privé (private deed) or by notary, together with the digital 'Création d'entreprise' dossier (M0-equivalent declaration) lodged through the INPI Guichet Unique, the attestation de blocage des fonds (certificate of capital deposit) and, upon completion, issuance of the Extrait K-bis (final RCS registration certificate).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital for a SARL is EUR 1 with no statutory maximum; however, any cash component must be fully paid up and subscribed at incorporation and the funds must be deposited and locked in escrow in a regulated French bank account, with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC), or with a notary pursuant to Article L.223-7 of the French Commercial Code; released funds are transferred only upon production of the RCS registration (K-bis). For the intraocular acrylic lens manufacturing activity, a commercially prudent paid-in capital of EUR 10,000 to EUR 50,000 is recommended to satisfy bank KYC, equipment leases, quality-management (ISO 13485) and environmental commitments.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE SHAREHOLDERS - FIRST ORGANIZATIONAL RESOLUTION. Upon adoption of the Articles of Association, the undersigned founder/shareholder: (i) resolves to incorporate [COMPANY] SARL, a societe a responsabilite limitee, with share capital of EUR [X] constituted of [X] equal nominal-value shares, fully subscribed and paid-up; (ii) adopts the registered office at [ADDRESS] in France as the sole domicile; (iii) ratifies the escrow of capital with the Caisse des Depots et Consignations pending registration; (iv) appoints [NAME] as sole Gerant for an indefinite term, with powers per Article L.223-18 of the French Commercial Code; and (v) authorises the Gerant to execute filings, publish the statutory notice, obtain the K-bis and perform every associated formality.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Statuts and Escrow Deposit of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founder's notary (optional) or private signature of the associates; regulated French bank or Caisse des Depots et Consignations holding the blocked capital consignation account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts sous seing prive containing the mandatory legal recitals: corporate name, corporate purpose covering high-precision lathe turning of foldable hydrophobic intraocular acrylic lenses (ISIC 3250 / NAF or APE 3250A), share capital amount and division into equal shares, registered office address, corporate duration (maximum 99 years), share transfer restrictions (agrement), and the designation and powers of the Gerant. Each associate subscribes in full and transfers his cash contribution into a dedicated blocked formation account ('compte de consignation pour constitution de societe'). Obtain the certificate of deposit (attestation de blocage des fonds) from the bank or CDC; where a notary is engaged, he verifies legal capacity, coordinates the subscription and issues the requisite capital certificate.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts signed by all associates
Identity documents (national ID or passport) of each associate
Proof of residential address of each associate (utility or tax bill)
Bank KYC and source-of-funds declaration
Business plan or corporate purpose statement supporting the mandatory banking assessment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the deposit on source-of-funds grounds, provide additional supporting transaction evidence or re-route the escrow through a notary; if a legal pre-inspection flags inconsistent Statuts clauses, amend and re-execute an up-signed version before the RCS filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorised Journal d'Annonces Legales (JAL) in the department where the registered office is situated; ordering is intermediated via the Guichet Unique portal or directly with the gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the mandatory formation announcement in the prescribed form: legal form (SARL), corporate name, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, identity of the Gerant and the RCS city of registration. Submit the draft to an authorised legal gazette; the publisher verifies the statutory content and issues the attestation de parution containing the publication date. The notice must be enforceable within the period prior to filing the RCS application; retain the attestation for attachment to the Guichet Unique dossier.
required_dossiers: Draft announcement text (projet d'annonce)
Certified copy of the Statuts for content verification by the publisher
Invoice settlement evidence for the publication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL rejects the draft for missing statutory recitals, immediately correct the text and re-submit; no material prejudice results provided the attestation de parution bears a date prior to the RCS registration filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Formation File via the INPI Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriete Industrielle (INPI) - Guichet Unique des formalites d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), transmitting the electronic dossier to the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online 'Creation d'entreprise' e-form (M0 equivalent) with all SARL particulars: legal form, denomination, corporate object, registered office, share capital, associates, and Gerant. Upload the signed Statuts, the attestation de blocage des fonds, the attestation de parution of the JAL, the justificatif de jouissance of the registered office, the identity of the Gerant and the Gerant's sworn declaration regarding no judicial disqualification. Pay the registry fee online and formally submit; follow the file in the Guichet Unique dashboard through transmission to the Greffe (filing to the RCS).
required_dossiers: Statuts signed by all associates
Attestation de blocage des fonds (bank or CDC certificate)
Attestation de parution of the legal notice
Justificatif de jouissance / lease or ownership proof of registered office
Identity document and sworn declaration of the Gerant (bulletin n°3 equivalent)
Completed M0 data set on the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the formality is placed 'en attente de complement', comply with the gap letter concerning missing documents within the statutory completion window; if the Greffe proposes rejection, submit observations and corrected documents within 15 days; in case of confirmed refusal, petition the President of the Tribunal de Commerce for an injunctive registration order under the RCS rectification procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Issuance of the Extrait K-bis
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (competent commercial registry for the registered office; records accessible through the Infogreffe portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Greffe examines the file, validates compliance, and registers the company; it assigns the SIREN number, the SIRET establishment number, and the APE code corresponding to ISIC 3250 (NAF 3250A - fabrication d'instruments et dispositifs medicaux). The company acquires legal personality as of the registration date. The exhibitor downloads the Extrait K-bis from Infogreffe; this certificate is the authoritative corporate identity evidence required for opening bank accounts, VAT formalities, customs clearance, lease execution, and later ANSM medical-device establishment registration.
required_dossiers: No new submission - the Guichet Unique file serves as the basis
Proof of payment of the registry fee
Optional physical K-bis order request via Infogreffe
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration exceeds the 5-working-day service standard, send a formal reminder through the Guichet Unique ticket channel; if the K-bis discloses transcription errors (name, address, capital), file a correction request ('demande de modification') with the Greffe within 5 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fiscal and Social Activation and Medical-Device Establishment Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP - Service des Impots des Entreprises) for VAT; URSSAF for social-security employer registration; ANSM (Agence nationale de securite du medicament et des produits de sante) and Eudamed for medical-device economic-operator registration under MDR 2017/745
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the K-bis, validate the SIRET references and apply to the competent SIE for the attachment of an intra-community VAT identification number (FR + 11 digits); register the company as employer with URSSAF under the standard social-registration procedure. Concurrently, before placing intraocular acrylic lenses on the market, the legal manufacturer must complete the EU MDR economic-operator registration under Eudamed and the national ANSM establishment registration, designating the Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC), retaining ISO 13485 quality-management documentation, and entering into a conformity-assess-ment route with a Notified Body (class III implantable devices).
required_dossiers: Extrait K-bis post-registration
Final Statuts
Registered office justification
Letter appointing the PRRC (qualified person with regulatory competence)
Contract with a Notified Body (e.g., LNE/G-MED) for class III conformity assessment
ISO 13485 quality-management certificate or roadmap
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VAT allocation is delayed, file an exceptional attestation request directly at the competent SIE counter; if ANSM or Eudamed rejects the establishment registration, correct the actor and Basic UDI-DI screens and re-submit within 30 days; if URSSAF delays the employer number, engage the local URSSAF office through physical application with the K-bis and Statuts.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence nationale de securite du medicament et des produits de sante (ANSM) as the French competent authority for medical devices under Regulation (EU) 2017/745; conformity certification by an accredited Notified Body (e.g., LNE/G-MED); industrial-site environmental oversight by Direction Regionale de l'Environnement, de l'Amenagement et du Logement (DREAL) under the ICPE regime of the French Environment Code.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Establishment registration of the legal manufacturer and economic operator for implantable medical devices at ANSM and Eudamed, combined with CE marking certification under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 for class III foldable intraocular hydrophobic acrylic lenses; the physical manufacturing facility further requires compliance with ICPE formalities where thresholds apply.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Regionale de l'Environnement, de l'Amenagement et du Logement (DREAL) - Installations Classees pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) division of the French Environment Code.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category D (Declaration regime) subject to a preliminary ICPE screening; small-and-medium precision-lathe shops dedicated to lens machining normally fall below the automatic 'Autorisation' threshold and are treated as exempt from a full EIA report unless annual solvent consumption reaches 2 tonnes or wastewater discharge limits are exceeded, in which case the 'Enregistrement' regime (Category E) / simplified environmental assessment applies.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Solvent inputs (acetone, isopropyl alcohol, metal-cleaning agents): must remain at or below the 2 tonnes per year, otherwise IED / Solvent Emissions Directive thresholds trigger additional abatement obligations; acrylic dust and polishing aerosols extracted by HEPA-filtered local exhaust ventilation with filtration efficiency at least 99.95%; wastewater to approve public sewer: pH 5.5-8.5, COD less than 2,000 mg/L, suspended solids less than 600 mg/L, oils and hydrocarbons less than 15 mg/L, absence of chlorinated solvents; solid acrylic offcuts and any grinding solids handled as non-hazardous industrial waste with a registered bordereau de suivi and disposal at an approved facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety compliance certificate based on the SDIS / Fire and Rescue Service prescriptions for industrial workshops (number of extinguishers, evacuation plan, flammable-solvent storage cabinets, electrical conformity); structural certification built on the construction-code 'controle technique' covering roof load, floor loading for CNC lathes, and hostile air extraction; occupational clearance by CARSAT / labour inspection including the mandatory Document Unique d'Evaluation des Risques Professionnels (DUER), electrical inspection of machines, EN/ISO machine-guard conformity, IEC wiring checks of clean-room and polishing equipment, and occupational-health surveillance arrangements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — 10 rue du Centre, 93160 Noisy-le-Grand; corporate and VAT e-filing portals: impots.gouv.fr (Espace Professionnel, EFI/TDFC, TVA ELEC). Customs and indirect duty authority: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) — 11 rue des Deux Communes, 93558 Montreuil; portal: douane.gouv.fr. Business registration single window: guichet-entreprises.gouv.fr (INPI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a newly formed French SARL with non-resident shareholders: (1) File incorporation with the Centre de Formalités des Entreprises via guichet-entreprises.gouv.fr to obtain SIREN/SIRET and RCS registration; (2) VAT number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire, format FR + key + SIREN) is automatically attributed by the local Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) upon completion of registration; for foreign non-established legal units, file CERFA Form 14048 (MOA) and designate a fiscal representative in France; (3) Obtain EORI number (format FR + 11 digits) from DGDDI via douane.gouv.fr for import/export operations; (4) Register as an ANSM medical-device economic operator for intraocular lens manufacturing (Class III, MDR 2017/745) as required by the statutory business licence; (5) Open a French bank account to receive incoming SWIFT wire transfers and letter-of-credit proceeds. Effective date of tax registration is the date of RCS filing; enforcement of VAT obligations starts from the first taxable transaction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France applies no US-style check-the-box regime. Default classification: SARL is subject to corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés, IS) at entity level at 25% standard rate (15% reduced rate on the first €42,000 of taxable profit for small enterprises meeting Article 219 CGI conditions, i.e., turnover ≤ €10M and 75% capital held by individuals). Pass-through election available solely under Article 239 bis AA CGI: for the first 5 fiscal years following creation, the SARL may elect to be taxed as a partnership (Impôt sur le Revenu, IR) if fewer than 50 employees and turnover below €10M (industrial/commercial activity) or €5M (services), by filing a written opt-in with the SIE within the statutory deadline; exit from election triggers deemed disposal rules. ATAD hybrid-mismatch reporting under Article 205 CGI applies to cross-border structures; controlled-foreign-company rules and interest limitation under Articles 209 B and 212 bis CGI; group fiscal integration available under Article 223 A CGI for ≥ 95% commonly held French subsidiaries; CVAE (contribution sur la valeur ajoutée des entreprises) applies at 0.75% maximum on value added, and CET (contribution économique territoriale) on rental/asset values for manufacturing sites.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée) governed by Articles 256 to 289 of the Code Général des Impôts, transposing EU Directive 2006/112/EC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Franchise en base de TVA (Article 293 B CGI, 2025 figures): €91,900 main turnover threshold for sale of goods (tolerance threshold €101,000) and €38,300 for supply of services (tolerance €41,000). Relevance to this entity: mandatory VAT registration without any threshold applies to all importers of goods into France, intra-Community acquirers, and manufacturers exporting outside the EU; thus the SARL is subject to full VAT registration effective from the first customs import or intra-EU acquisition. Intra-EU distance sales (OSS) trigger registration at €10,000 annual EU-wide distance-sales threshold (Article 258 C CGI). No manufacturing exemption applies to medical devices; intraocular lens B2B supplies are taxable at the 20% standard rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: French e-invoicing reform (Loi de Finances 2024, Article 12; Decree n° 2022-1299): phased mandatory deployment — from 1 September 2026 all VAT-registered companies must receive electronic invoices, and large enterprises (GE) plus mid-sized enterprises (ETI) must issue them; from 1 September 2027 all SMEs/micro-enterprises must issue e-invoices. Transmission only via certified Plateformes de Dématérialisation Partenaires (PDP) or the central Portail Public de Facturation (PPF); accepted formats: Factur-X (hybrid PDF/XML), UBL, and CII. No real-time per-invoice fiscal clearance or digital stamping (unlike Italy's SDI); instead, B2C transaction data must be submitted as e-reporting through the PDP/PPF within 2 business days of invoice issuance. Intra-EU trade: monthly Intrastat (DES) filings required once annual dispatches exceed €460,000 (2025). Penalties for non-compliant e-invoicing: €15 per invoice (cap €15,000/year) under Article 1737 CGI; €250 per omitted e-reporting transaction.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of physical goods (including classified intraocular lenses) to destinations outside the EU are taxable at 0% VAT with full input VAT recovery under Article 262-I-1° CGI, provided physical export is evidenced within 90 days of dispatch. Intra-Community dispatches are exempt with credit under Article 262-I-2° CGI where: the customer communicates a valid intra-EU VAT number, goods are physically transported to another Member State, and the recapitulative statement (DEB) is filed via the DES. Zero-rating also applies to ancillary services (freight, transport, installation performed outside the EU) per Articles 259 A and 262-II CGI. The right to deduct input VAT on exported medical-device components is retained. Documentary proof must be kept for 10 years (Article L. 102 B of the Livre des Procédures Fiscales).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration d'Exportation) lodged via the DELTA/GCA electronic customs system (AES/ICS movement reference confirmed by DGDDI)
Bill of Lading (maritime) or Air Waybill (airfreight) confirming physical dispatch to a non-EU destination
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT evidence proving collection of export proceeds in foreign currency
Commercial invoice (bilingual FR/EN; HS 9021.39 for intraocular lenses) stating Incoterms and export VAT at 0%
Packing list showing gross/net weight and number of packages
Certificate of origin (EUR.1, Form A, REX statement, or importer-side origin declaration) where preferential duty treatment is claimed
Proof of signed delivery note / transport manifest (POD or CMR letter) for intra-EU dispatch verification
Intra-Community recapitulative declaration (DEB/DES) referencing the counterpart's valid FR/other EU VAT number
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is a priority joint audit target of the DGFiP and DGDDI. Deficiency consequences: immediate reassessment of VAT at 20% on the gross invoice value (rappel de TVA) plus recovery of any previously refunded input VAT; civil penalty of 80% for fraudulent manoeuvres (Article 1729-b CGI, manœuvres frauduleuses) or 40% for bad faith (mauvaise foi), plus 0.20% per month late interest (Article 1727 CGI). Criminal exposure under Article 1741 CGI: up to €750,000 fine and 5 years' imprisonment (€2,000,000 and 7 years for organized fraud). Customs sanctions under Articles 414 and 419 Code des Douanes: fine between 1× and 2× the value of the irregular goods, confiscation of means of transport, suspension or withdrawal of EORI status and AEO authorisation for up to 3 years. Retrospective clawback window: the general 3-year statute of limitations (Article L. 169 LPF) extends to 10 years for undisclosed international operations (Article L. 169 B LPF). Non-filing or late correction of Intrastat declarations triggers €750 per declaration or amendment. In practice, the French customs authority verifies the convergence of customs export records, transport documents, bank inward remittances, and VAT refund claims; any mismatch above de minimis thresholds automatically triggers a formal reassessment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France — Direction Générale de la Stabilité Financière et des Opérations (DGSO) and the balance-of-payments statistical directorate; prudential supervision and licensing of credit institutions is exercised by the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR); AML/CFT financial intelligence supervision by TRACFIN. Legal basis: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.141-6, L.151-3, L.511-1 et seq., and R.561-1 et seq.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible for current and capital account transactions; France imposes no exchange control licence, conversion ratio, or approval requirement on trade settlements, dividend remittances, intercompany loans, or share capital inflows. Free movement of capital is guaranteed by TFEU Article 63 and Directive 88/361/EEC. Residual restrictions apply only under EU/UN sanctions regimes (with asset-freeze screening), financial embargoes on listed counterparties, and the French FDI screening decree (Decree 2019-1590, with EU Regulation 2019/452) for non-EEA investors acquiring control over sensitive sectors with state-security or health-vulnerability exposure. Greenfield manufacturing of intraocular acrylic lenses by an existing SARL does not, in itself, trigger prior FDI authorisation unless the technology is classified as dual-use or is deemed critical health infrastructure. Dividend and profit repatriation are unrestricted once annual accounts are approved, corporate tax filings are current (IS, CET, TVA), and transfer-pricing documentation substantiates arm's-length pricing. Payments to blacklisted non-cooperative jurisdictions (juridictions non coopératives) may be blocked for tax deduction but not exchange-rationed. Practical residual friction: banks apply internal country-risk overlays, prolonged Beneficial-Owner (UBO) due diligence, and SOF (source-of-funds) documentary requirements on inbound capital injections from high-risk jurisdictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no statutory surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion into EUR, no repatriation deadline, and no export proceeds retention quota. Export invoices may be collected in EUR, USD, or any freely convertible currency, and the resulting balances may be maintained indefinitely in a foreign-currency current account with an ACPR-licensed credit institution. However, the SARL must comply with (i) Automatic cross-border transaction reporting executed by the paying/receiving bank into the Banque de France balance-of-payments dataset — the SARL must respond to the bank's periodic statistical requests; (ii) The annual foreign account declaration (next to the income tax return) under Article 1649 A of the Code général des impôts — form n° 3916-bis-SD — covering every bank, securities, or crypto account held outside France, with fines for omission; (iii) EU customs Extrastat declarations for extra-EEA shipments, and Intrastat if intra-EEA dispatches exceed threshold; (iv) Transfer-pricing documentation under Article 57 CGI demonstrating that export proceeds are economically aligned with invoiced values and payment terms; a persistent build-up of unrepatriated receivables at a related offshore distributor can trigger reallocation of profits by the French tax administration.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital escrow account for the SARL in formation (compte séquestre/bloqué pour apport en numéraire) plus multicurrency operational EUR/USD treasury account and documentary credit desk
Operational current account (compte courant), export LC advising/confirmation line, FX forward facility (change à terme ferme), and SEPA/TARGET2 clearing

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Industriel et Commercial S.A. (CIC, Crédit Mutuel Alliance Fédérale)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational account with access to import LC issuance under UCP600 and supply-chain finance

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank / LCL
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EUR account with regional corporate centre; limited appetite for high-risk medical-device documentary credit exposure
Retail and cash management services only; no trade finance, no SWIFT documentary capability, incompatible with the High_Risk_Special_License classification

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts approval by the shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No filing authority; approval by the shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The president of the commercial court may order the manager to convene the shareholders, potentially subject to a daily coercive fine; no automatic strike-off deadline applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposit, including the approved accounts and applicable reports
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial court registry (greffe) for the competent RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval, or within two months if filed electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A court order to file may be issued, potentially subject to a daily coercive fine. Failure to file does not trigger automatic strike-off after a fixed period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (Form 2065 and schedules, where subject to French corporate income tax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French tax administration (Direction générale des Finances publiques)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, by the second working day after 1 May, subject to the administration's applicable filing calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing generally attracts a 10% surcharge, increased in specified circumstances, plus late-payment interest; prolonged non-compliance may lead to tax assessment and collection enforcement, not automatic corporate strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-owner declaration, only upon a reportable change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial court registry (greffe) for the competent RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after a change affecting previously declared beneficial-owner information; no routine annual reconfirmation is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to declare may result in criminal penalties for the responsible natural person and the entity, and court-ordered compliance; no automatic strike-off deadline applies.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor is generally required when the SARL exceeds at least two of these three thresholds at the financial year-end: EUR 5 million total balance sheet, EUR 10 million net turnover, and 50 employees. Separate rules may apply to qualifying groups, regulated activities, or shareholder requests.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French statutory accounts must be prepared under French GAAP (Plan comptable général). IFRS is not the ordinary framework for an individual SARL's statutory accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no general annual beneficial-owner confirmation filing. File an updated declaration with the RCS within 30 days after a reportable change. Record share transfers in the company's shareholder documentation and complete any required registration and tax formalities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholder records and share-transfer documentation)
Register of Directors (manager appointment and cessation records)
Minute Book (shareholder decisions and required corporate minutes)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: EUR 300–1,500 annually (approximately USD 325–1,625); commercial-provider pricing varies by service and location
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: EUR 3,000–10,000 annually (approximately USD 3,250–10,850) when a statutory audit is required; scope and complexity materially affect fees

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate); 15% applies to the first €42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying small and medium enterprises (turnover ≤ €10m, paid-up capital ≤ €750k)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Research tax credit (CIR) at 30% of qualifying R&D expenditure up to €100m and 5% above; Innovation tax credit (CII) for SMEs; reduced 10% rate on qualifying patent-box / IP licensing and assignment income; Young Innovative Company (JEI) exemption status for SMEs under 8 years; reduced SME tax rate on first profit bracket
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite (no fixed-year limit); annual utilization capped at €1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable income exceeding that threshold

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Liasse fiscale on Form 2065-SD (and supplementary schedules 2050 to 2058) filed exclusively via EDI-TDFC electronic platform on impots.gouv.fr; associated corporate income tax balance paid through EDI-TVA
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly advance payments (acomptes) due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December, followed by a final settlement called at the time of annual filing
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal years ending on 31 December: electronic filing due on the second business day after 1 May (effectively 5 May in most years); for off-calendar fiscal years: filing due within three months of the closing date

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reports the net taxable result after adding back disallowed expenses, offsetting prior-year losses and applying capital gains regime; central box for determination of the corporate tax base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident company should restrict entry to French-source profits attributable to a permanent establishment; attach a treaty business-profits schedule if reliance is claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allocates profit among distributable reserves, dividend payments and directors' fees; feeding basis for dividend withholding tax on distributed sums.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a distribution to non-resident shareholders is declared, disclose shareholder residence and tax identification and attach IFU form to evidence withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible managerial remuneration, employer social taxes and expense allowances paid to the SARL manager or non-executive directors; arm’s length analysis required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident manager, document actual French employment activities, social-security affiliation and any DTA transfer-of-residence assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declares research tax credit, patent-box deduction and innovation credit linked to intraocular lens development; requires attachment of Form 2069-A for R&D substantiation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit is reserved for R&D physically conducted by the French establishment; non-resident licensors must provide evidence of local laboratory contracts and cost tracking.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 5% penalty on the assessed tax, increased to 10% if not remedied within 30 days after a formal notice; late-payment interest accrues at 0.2% per month; failure to provide statutory tax documentation incurs €15 to €1,500 per document; intentional concealment exposes an 80% penalty.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 30% dividend withholding tax under Article 119 bis CGI, reduced to 0% for qualifying EU parent companies under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (at least 10% holding for two years) and further reduced under applicable double-taxation agreements (typically 0-15%)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident beneficial owner obtains a certified tax residence certificate (TRC) from its home jurisdiction, submits it to the French paying agent or directly to the local tax administration (SIE) along with proper form IFU/5002; relief may be applied at source when documentation is provided before payment; if withheld, refund claims must be filed within the statutory limitation period (generally two years) with underlying dividend documentation
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory withholding tax of 33.33% under Article 182 B CGI; treaty rates typically 0-10%; EU Interest & Royalty Directive provides 0% for related enterprises. Interest: generally no statutory withholding tax on ordinary corporate interest, except punitive rates of 50% or 75% on payments to beneficiaries in non-cooperative jurisdictions (Article 238 A CGI); treaty rate often 0%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Full Transfer Pricing Master File and Local File mandatory for taxpayers exceeding EU SME thresholds: turnover (excl. VAT) > €50 million, balance sheet total > €43 million, or 250+ employees; Country-by-Country Report required when consolidated group revenue exceeds €750 million
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not apply a separate Crown-dependency-style ESR, but requires genuine economic substance through the abuse-of-law doctrine (Article L64 LPF), beneficial-ownership concepts and CFC rules (Article 209 B CGI). An intraocular lens manufacturer must maintain real industrial presence, including physical facilities, qualified technical staff, strategic decision-making and risk-taking functions in France; arrangements with foreign affiliates must be justified by actual operational activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying commercial invoices, under-declaring sales of medical lenses, recording offshore payments without business substance, or deliberately omitting taxable income derived from high-risk procurement contracts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax reassessment with 40% penalty for bad faith or 80% penalty for fraudulent manoeuvre; criminal prosecution under Article 1741 CGI carries five-year imprisonment and a €500,000 fine; mandatory publication of the judgment; denial of tax deduction rights for clandestine transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, de facto managers and majority shareholders can be held criminally liable; piercing the corporate veil is permitted where the SARL is a mere alter ego; civil restitution of surreptitious profits; travel bans and exit controls during fraud investigations; disqualification from managing French companies

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating or maintaining a French SARL with no actual employees, premises or industrial activity solely to attract French R&D credits, patent-box benefits, treaty access or favourable loss offsetting; circular intra-group transactions with foreign shell entities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article L64 LPF abuse-of-law procedure recharacterises the claimed tax base; penalty increased to 80% where the arrangement has no commercial rationale; denial of treaty benefits; administrative fine for reporting abusive schemes; disallowance of the French corporate personality for tax purposes
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be jointly and severally liable for recaptured corporate tax and penalties; courts may pierce the corporate veil to enforce personal liability; criminal exposure for organised tax fraud; asset freezes and travel restrictions during judicial review

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money Laundering and Export-Control Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving large or unexplained swift wires or letters of credit from opaque jurisdictions, dealing in counterfeit medical devices, bribery in public hospital tenders, or failing to file suspicious-transaction reports with TRACFIN (French financial intelligence unit)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money-laundering offence carries up to ten years' imprisonment and €750,000 fine; non-compliance with AML registration and reporting duties triggers administrative fines by the ACPR; asset forfeiture for instruments and proceeds; revocation of CE-mark or import/export licences required for intraocular lens distribution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: AML obligations bind the SARL's directors and effective beneficial owners; corporate veil is pierced to reach personal assets; travel bans, passport withdrawal and freezing orders are routinely imposed; conviction leads to prison, disqualification from company management and publication of the sanction
